item.title: West Virginia Department of Agriculture confirms positive case of bird flu in Kanawha County flock - WOAY-TV
item.description: The West Virginia Department of Agriculture has confirmed a case of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza in a backyard flock in Kanawha County. Officials say this marks the sixth detection in domestic backyard birds in the state since 2022. The case was confirmed after testing at the state’s animal health lab, and the affected property has been placed under quarantine. #KanawhaCounty #WOAY

item.title: WVU Tech invites prospective students to Discovery Day on March 28 - WOAY-TV
item.description: WVU Tech is inviting prospective students and their families to visit campus later this month. The university's “Discover Day” is set for Saturday, March 28, giving future Golden Bears a chance to experience campus life firsthand. The event runs from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., starting in Carter Hall. #RaleighCounty #WOAY

item.title: Summersville Police Department celebrates the retirement of K9 officers Nommie and Erna - WOAY-TV
item.description: Two longtime members of the Summersville Police Department are being honored for their service. K9s Nommie and Erna are officially retiring after years of working alongside their handlers to protect the community. #NicholasCounty #WOAY

item.title: Bill Withers Committee accepting entries for Lovely Day Contest until June 3 - WOAY-TV
item.description: The Bill Withers Committee is now accepting entries for its annual “Lovely Day” Creative Arts Contest, celebrating the legacy of Beckley native Bill Withers. The contest aims to introduce young people to Withers’ music and inspire them to express themselves creatively through what they hear and feel. #RaleighCounty #WOAY

item.title: Deadline to apply for Active SWV Spring Kids Run Club Mini Grant on March 25 - WOAY-TV
item.description: Active Southern West Virginia is accepting applications for this spring's Kids-Run Club mini-grant. Teachers, school staff, and community groups are urged to apply to start a local club to encourage kids to stay active. The mini-grant provides training, end-of-season medals, technical support, and $250 in funding for exercise equipment and other essentials. The application deadline is Wednesday, March 25.

item.title: Bonnie’s Bus mobile mammography unit to visit Nicholas County on April 21-22 - WOAY-TV
item.description: Bonnie’s Bus is making stops in Nicholas County this April, offering three-dimensional screening mammograms and breast care education to women. The mobile unit from WVU Medicine and the WVU Cancer Institute will be at the Camden Family Health locations in Summersville on April 21 and in Craigsville on April 22, with appointments available from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. #NicholasCounty #WOAY

item.title: Wyoming County Sheriff’s deputies undergo D.A.R.E officer training to encourage young people to make good decisions - WOAY-TV
item.description: Members of the Wyoming County Sheriff’s Office are strengthening their efforts to connect with young people. Over the past two weeks, deputies completed specialized D.A.R.E. officer training alongside law enforcement from across the region. #WyomingCounty #WOAY
